chunks: The ghusl of janabah and menstruation is one and the same.

Aḥmad ibn ʿAbdūn informed me, from ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad ibn al-Zubayr, from ʿAlī ibn Faḍḍāl, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Zurārah, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī al-Ḥalabī, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
And I asked Abā ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام about the menstruating woman: is there upon her a ghusl like the ghusl of the junub? He said: Yes.

key_terms.الْجَنَابَةِ: the state of major ritual impurity caused by janabah
key_terms.الْجُنُبِ: a person in the state of janabah
key_terms.نَعَمْ: an affirmative answer establishing the ruling

ai.seo_question: Is the ghusl of menstruation the same as the ghusl of janabah in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling that the ghusl required after menstruation is the same as the ghusl of janabah. It indicates equivalence in the form of ritual purification required for both states.
